title: Overwatch Retail Patch Notes – September 17, 2026
note:
### Overwatch Retail Patch Notes – September 17, 2026

#### Hotfix Update

This is a hotfix update. Replay codes from the September 8, 2026 patch are still available.

#### Hero Updates

![D.Mon](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/xXRg/256X256/patch-2026-08-12-97bf4d7039-01-t.png)

##### D.Mon

* Armor reduced from 325 to 275 (5v5).
* Armor reduced from 300 to 250 (6v6).

**Focused Fusion - Major Perk**

* Damage per bullet reduced from 45 to 36.

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/49At/128X128/patch-2026-08-12-97bf4d7039-03-t.png)

Propulsors

* Fuel drain rate increased from 25 to 30.

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/F5fX/128X128/patch-2026-08-12-97bf4d7039-04-t.png)

Fusion Repeater

* Damage reduced from 16 to 15.
* Cooldown increased from 4 to 5 seconds.

#### Bug Fixes

Stadium

* Fixed a gameplay issue with Mercy in Stadium. She has been re-enabled in all Stadium queues.

### 《守望先锋》补丁说明 – 2026年9月17日

#### 不停机更新

本次为不停机更新。2026年9月8日补丁的回放代码仍可使用。

#### 英雄更新

![D.Mon](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/xXRg/256X256/patch-2026-08-12-97bf4d7039-01-t.png)

##### D.Mon

* 护甲值从325降低至275（5v5）。
* 护甲值从300降低至250（6v6）。

**聚焦聚变（Focused Fusion）——主要威能**

* 每发子弹伤害从45降低至36。

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/49At/128X128/patch-2026-08-12-97bf4d7039-03-t.png)

助推器

* 燃料消耗速率从25提高至30。

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/F5fX/128X128/patch-2026-08-12-97bf4d7039-04-t.png)

聚变连发枪

* 伤害从16降低至15。
* 冷却时间从4秒增加至5秒。

#### 错误修复

角斗领域

* 修复了天使在角斗领域中的一项游戏问题。天使已在所有角斗领域队列中重新开放。
